outcome_summary: Checkpoints 01 (Reconstruction Completeness) and 02 (Bilateral Soundness) are unconditionally verified (20/20 Lean 4.35.0 headlines in Rule30PrizeClosure). All-white, all-black, and P=1 center periods are unconditionally excluded for all transients T, and window_jen + PSMSL FutureWorkEquiv establishes an explicit constructive linear re-entry bound forcing M pairwise distinct FutureWorkEquiv classes across any M return periods. Checkpoint 03/04 universal lifting (M4) is isolated to two exact open obligations: (Track A/C) F_2 non-vanishing of the overdetermined degree-2 cone polynomial system in 2T-2 variables, or (Track B) a sub-linear upper bound on realizable single-seed FutureWorkEquiv classes.

obligations.title: General periodic-center-to-initial-state reconstruction
obligations.unresolved_gap: None: exact forward left-half word operator and unit-triangular backward reconstruction are verified for all T and L.

obligations.title: Complete bilateral compatibility criterion
obligations.unresolved_gap: None: exact bilateral conservation cell t (-1) xor orCol 0 t = cell (t+1) 0 and obsLeftWord = orColWord are kernel-verified.

obligations.title: Infinite-horizon obstruction
obligations.unresolved_gap: All-white, all-black, P=1, long-black-run (b>=9), and linear-horizon FutureWorkEquiv collisions are unconditionally obstructed for all T; general mixed short-run periods P>=2 are obstructed at bounded (T, P) but lack a uniform all-(T, P) invariant.

obligations.title: Universal lifting theorem
obligations.unresolved_gap: Requires either (A/C) an F_2 Nullstellensatz / non-vanishing theorem on the overdetermined degree-2 cone polynomials in 2T-2 variables, or (B) a sub-linear upper bound on realizable FutureWorkEquiv classes to contradict the Omega(M) window_jen lower bound.

obligations.title: Formal end-to-end proof composition
obligations.unresolved_gap: End-to-end implications to Rule30Prize.Problem1 are kernel-verified, awaiting an unconditional proof of either M4 obligation.
